claims.value: Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) is a 24B parameter instruction-finetuned model that adds state-of-the-art vision understanding and long context capabilities up to 128k tokens. It is an instruction-finetuned version of Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Base-2503.
claims.evidence: Building upon Mistral Small 3 (2501), Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) **adds state-of-the-art vision understanding** and enhances **long context capabilities up to 128k tokens** without compromising text performance.
Vision capabilities enable the model to analyze images and provide insights based on visual content in addition to text.
Agent-Centric: Offers best-in-class agentic capabilities with native function calling and JSON outputting.

claims.value: Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) is a 24B parameter instruction-finetuned model under Apache 2.0 license.
Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) is a 24B parameter instruction-finetuned model deployable on a single RTX 4090 or 32GB RAM MacBook when quantized.
claims.evidence: Mistral Small 3.1 can be deployed locally and is exceptionally "knowledge-dense," fitting within a single RTX 4090 or a 32GB RAM MacBook once quantized.

claims.value: Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) supports 28 languages including English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Chinese, Arabic, and others.

claims.value: Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) uses a Tekken tokenizer with a 131k vocabulary size.
